lines.en: String taut, I traverse the ancient ruins.
Arrow slices through the dim air.
In darkness, I seek a target.
Arrow flies, aiming for the target.
Curse arrow, aimed at the foe.
Empty armor walks on its own.
Iron boots crunch the ruin's rubble.

lines.zh: 我沿着藏宝的走廊巡逻。
lines.en: I patrol the corridor of treasures.
Bow in hand, I prepare to strike.

lines.zh: 黑夜给了我弓箭的力量。
lines.en: Night gives me the bow's power.
Bow on my knee, not a tremor.

lines.zh: 盔甲里空空的，没有呼吸。
lines.en: My armor is hollow. No breath inside.
The curse core hums in my chest.

lines.zh: 我数着遗迹里的每块砖。
lines.en: I count every brick in the ruin.
Aim at you, arrow on string.
Gaze at you, ready to shoot.

lines.zh: 我的头盔里没有眼，只有准星。
lines.en: There are no eyes in my helm, only a sight line.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动，我都知道。
lines.en: I know every move you make.

lines.zh: 我的弓，守在这堆财宝上。
你的脚步声在石廊里太响。
lines.en: Your steps echo too loudly in the stone hall.

lines.zh: 宝藏在你身后，不在你手里。
lines.en: The treasure is behind you, not in your hands.

lines.zh: 我看不见眼睛，却看得见你。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I see you.
The bow is drawn. Do not move.
Back out. I count to three.

lines.zh: 二十点血肉，挡不住一箭。
lines.en: Twenty points of flesh will not stop an arrow.

lines.zh: 盔甲碎了，箭矢也快没了！
这箭伤太重了，我撑不住了！
lines.en: This arrow wound is too deep, I can't hold on.

lines.zh: 箭矢无用了，我必须离开！
lines.en: Arrows are useless, I must retreat.

lines.zh: 财宝是我的责任，我必须守护！
lines.en: Treasure is my duty, I must protect it.

lines.zh: 诅咒让我受伤，但我不会倒下！
lines.en: Curse hurts me, but I won't fall.

lines.zh: 我无法继续战斗了，财宝安全为重！
lines.en: Cannot fight anymore, treasure safety first.

lines.zh: 我需要休息，恢复后再战！
它盯着你，似乎要射穿你的灵魂。
lines.en: It fixes you with an arrow of gaze.
Come closer, the bow is strung.

lines.zh: 你的肉眼无法捕捉它的形影。
lines.en: Your eyes cannot see its form.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中透出饥饿的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a hungry light.

lines.zh: 它似乎在等待一个机会。
它在暗中窥伺，寻找弱点。
lines.en: It stalks in the dark, seeking weakness.

lines.zh: 它的盔甲闪耀着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its armor glows with an eerie light.

lines.zh: 它的叫声让人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its voice sends shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 盔甲的碰撞声震耳欲聋。
它的盔甲保护它免受伤害。
它们相互对视，眼中闪烁着光芒。

lines.en: Its mate waits in the distance.

lines.zh: 它们彼此靠近，寻找结合。
它的伴侣发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Its mate makes a low sound.

lines.zh: 它们之间形成了一种联系。
它的伴侣似乎在召唤它。
lines.en: Its mate seems to call to it.

lines.zh: 它们彼此依靠，互相保护。
lines.en: They rely on each other, protecting.

lines.zh: 它们彼此低语，交流信息。
lines.en: They whisper to each other, communicating.

lines.zh: 它的伴侣在它身边守护。
lines.en: Its mate guards by its side.

lines.zh: 你手碰到财宝的那一刻，弦就响了。
lines.en: The string sings the moment you touch the hoard.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲不会轻易破碎！
lines.en: My armor does not easily break.
You must pay for the treasure.

lines.zh: 这副空盔甲守着遗迹的财宝。
lines.en: This empty armor guards the ruin's treasure.

lines.zh: 石廊那头有人，我拉满了弓。
lines.en: Someone at the far end of the hall — my bow is full.

lines.zh: 空盔甲里，弓自己转向了你。
lines.en: Inside the empty armor, the bow turns to you on its own.

lines.zh: 空盔甲里，只有弓还听话。
lines.en: In this empty armor, only the bow obeys.

lines.zh: 你将为你的罪孽付出代价！
你会在我的视线中倒下！

lines.en: My bow is aimed at you.

lines.zh: 拉满的弓从我空空的肩后伸出。
lines.en: A drawn bow extends from behind my hollow shoulder.

lines.zh: 箭尾的羽毛擦过我的臂甲。
lines.en: Fletching brushes against my arm guard.
My bow and arrow never miss.

lines.zh: 我的箭矢将带给你死亡！
一支箭钉进你脚边的石板。
lines.en: An arrow bites the flagstone by your feet.

lines.zh: 我用灵魂之箭守护宝藏！
lines.en: I protect the treasure with soul arrows!
You can’t escape, no arrow goes waste!

lines.zh: 远古遗迹中，我守护宝藏！
lines.en: In ancient ruins, I guard the treasure!
This is the place of bound souls!

lines.zh: 诅咒核心，我的力量源泉！

lines.en: I am the Possessed Armor Archer!

lines.zh: 遗迹的石门开了，我站起来。
lines.en: The ruin's stone door opens; I rise.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来了，盔甲受伤！
水淹没了我，盔甲无法保护我！
诅咒之力穿透了我的盔甲！
这副空甲里，什么都没剩。
lines.en: Nothing is left inside this empty armor.

lines.zh: 闪电击中了我，盔甲受损！
进入虚无空间，盔甲无法保护我！
